plan.summary: Gun & Powder was shown as a 'national tour' that merged two separate productions (Signature Theatre 2020, Paper Mill 2024) and repeated 12 of their reviews on a third page. Remove the roll-up, keep each production's own reviews and score, link the Broadway show Wanted to the Paper Mill production it grew from.
steps: Take the fake Gun & Powder tour roll-up apart: drop its 12 copied review rows (each has a twin on the Signature or Paper Mill page), clear tourParent on both runs, link Wanted to the Paper Mill production, alias the old URL to it
Retire the aggregate row (provisional, zero reviews after the unlink step)

actions.oldValue: A new musical based on the real-life story of Mary and Martha Clarke, twin sisters who take up arms to save their family from ruin in 1893 Texas. World premiere at Signature Theatre; later retitled *Wanted* for its 2024 Paper Mill Playhouse engagement and 2026 Broadway transfer.
actions.newValue: A new musical based on the real-life story of Mary and Martha Clarke, twin sisters who take up arms to save their family from ruin in 1893 Texas. World premiere at Signature Theatre in 2020. A separate production followed at Paper Mill Playhouse in 2024, and the musical reached Broadway in 2026 as *Wanted*.

actions.reason: Not a tour: the 2020 Signature Theatre premiere and the 2024 Paper Mill Playhouse production were different productions (different director and cast, four years apart). The roll-up copied both runs' reviews onto a third page (BRO-7192)
